card: Skips unconfirmed wallet transaction resubmission entirely when -privatebroadcast is set. When the network drops an unconfirmed transaction, re-adding it to the local mempool permits peers to request it directly, identifying the node as the originator and defeating private broadcast privacy. This change suppresses periodic rebroadcast as well as mempool insertion on wallet load for users opted into -privatebroadcast.
changed_since_previous: The earlier approach suppressed P2P broadcast announcements during periodic resubmissions while still re-adding transactions to the local mempool. The updated implementation skips ResubmitWalletTransactions entirely under -privatebroadcast, preventing transactions from being re-added to the mempool periodically, at startup, or upon loading a wallet.
evidence: PR description: 'for users opting into private broadcast, it seems a bridge too far for them to expect the current behavior. e.g. an incoming dust payment triggering your node to rebroadcast 24-36th later over clearnet'

Commit 704238cf4f: 'A transaction that the rest of the network has dropped is then held by this node alone, and served to any peer that asks for it, which marks it as the node's own. Not announcing the re-added transaction does not hide this: any relay peer can fetch anything in the mempool once the next inv round has passed.'
problem: When the rest of the network evicts an unconfirmed transaction, re-adding it to the local mempool leaves it held exclusively by the originating node, allowing peers to request it and deanonymize the sender. Even without actively broadcasting an announcement, holding an otherwise dropped transaction in the mempool undermines the origin privacy expected by users running with `-privatebroadcast`.

risk.why: Unconfirmed transactions dropped from network mempools will not automatically rebroadcast when -privatebroadcast is enabled, potentially leaving stuck transactions unconfirmed without user intervention.

summary: Disables wallet transaction resubmission entirely when `-privatebroadcast` is enabled. The wallet skips re-adding unconfirmed transactions to the local mempool on startup, wallet load, import, and periodic rebroadcast intervals.
